curiosity: Curiosity helps us find new things.

currency: We buy food with currency at the market.

darkroom: My father works in a darkroom.

dauntless: The dauntless girl walks into the long tunnel.

debt: Getting out of debt is hard.

decision: It is hard to make a big decision.

decline: I had to decline candy at the store.

decompose: Old leaves decompose in the wet forest.
湿润的森林里，老树叶会慢慢腐烂。
How long does an apple take to decompose?
一个苹果要多久才会分解呀？

看，这段旧木头会腐烂变成泥土呢！
decomposition: Decomposition turns old leaves into dirt.

dedicate: She dedicated her new book to her mother.

dedication: It takes dedication to play the drum well.

deduction: His deduction about the dog was right.

鸵鸟为什么会进入防备状态呀？

别嫌弃朋友送的礼物哦。
destined: The little seed was destined to be a tree.
这颗小种子注定要长成大树。
Is every acorn destined to be a tree?
每颗橡子都注定会长成大树吗？
You are destined to do big things!
你天生就是要做大事的！
destitute: We help destitute families with food and coats.
我们用食物和外套帮助贫困的家庭。
What can we give to a destitute family?
我们能给困难的家庭些什么呢？
Let's give our old coats to destitute families.
我们把旧外套送给贫困的家庭吧。
destructive: The big fire was very destructive.
那场大火破坏力特别大。
Did the destructive water get into your house?
破坏力很强的雨水进你们家了吗？

detain: Rain can detain us at the store.
下雨会让我们困在商店里。
Why did you detain my little brother?
你为什么拦住我弟弟呀？
Don't detain me, I want to go home!
detect: The dog can detect the cat under the bed.
小狗能发现躲在床底下的猫。
Can the eagle detect a fish from high up?
老鹰能从高空中发现鱼吗？
Try to detect who ate the cookie!
侦探一下，是谁吃了饼干！
detention: He got detention for running in the classroom.
他在教室里乱跑，被留堂了。
Did you get detention at school today?
你今天在学校被留堂了吗？
Be good at school so you don't get detention.
在学校要守规矩，就不会被留堂。
determination: Determination helps you do hard things.
Does determination help you play good soccer?
有决心能让你足球踢得更好吗？
Use determination when the work is hard!
功课难的时候，就要拿出决心来！
determined: The determined turtle did not stop.
坚定的小乌龟没有停下。
Are you determined to jump over the high fence?
你有决心跳过高高的栅栏吗？
Be determined and try one more time.
detestable: It is detestable to say bad words.
为什么难听的话惹人讨厌呀？
请别再弄那讨厌的噪音啦！
detour: Our bus made a detour by the market.
我们的公交车绕道经过了市场。
Why is there a detour on this street?
这条街为什么要绕行呀？
devastating: The devastating rain was hard for the little birds.
那场可怕的暴雨可苦了小鸟们。
Why was the big fire so devastating?
那场大火怎么破坏得那么严重呀？
Let's plant trees where the devastating fire was.
我们在大火烧过的地方种树吧。
devastation: The big fire made devastation in the forest.
大火把森林糟蹋得一片狼藉。
What made the devastation in the old city?
老城里那么严重的破坏是怎么造成的呀？
Let's clean up the devastation together!
我们一起把狼藉清理干净吧！
develop: Plants develop fast in the warm rain.
How do baby birds develop in the egg?
雏鸟在蛋里是怎么长大的呀？
Try new things and develop every day.
多尝试新事物，天天进步。
developing: The developing plant needs water and light.
正在生长的植物需要水和阳光。
When will the developing baby bird get out?
还在发育的小鸟什么时候出壳呀？
Wow, the developing seed has two small leaves!
哇，正在发芽的种子长出两片小叶子啦！
development: Good food helps the development of your body.
好好吃东西有助于身体发育。
What helps the development of baby birds?
什么能帮助雏鸟成长呀？
Let's watch the development of our little plants.
我们来观察小植物的生长吧！
device: My new device can play music.
What is this little device on the desk?
桌上这个小设备是什么呀？
Put your device down and read a book.
把设备放下，看会儿书吧。
devious: That devious cat got your fish again.
那只狡猾的猫又偷到你的鱼了。
Why is that monkey so devious?
那只猴子怎么那么鬼灵精呀？
Watch out for the devious old fox!
当心那只狡猾的老狐狸！
devise: She devised a way to get the kite down.
她想出了把风筝拿下来的办法。
Can you devise a fun game for us?
你能给我们想个好玩的吗？
Let's devise a new song for the picnic!
我们来编一首野餐新歌吧！
devotion: Her devotion to her family never stops.
她对家人的关爱从不停歇。
Do you see the mother bird's devotion?
你看到鸟妈妈的全心付出了吗？
Wow, what devotion to her little babies!
哇，她对宝宝们真是全心付出呀！
devour: Lions devour their food very fast.
Did the crocodile devour the big fish?
鳄鱼把大鱼吞下去了吗？
Watch the dinosaur devour its lunch!
快看恐龙大口吞吃午饭！
dexterity: Dexterity is doing small things well.
手脚灵巧就是小事也做得好。
Why does a pilot need dexterity?
飞行员为什么需要灵巧的身手呀？
Wow, look at the dexterity of that robot!
哇，快看那个机器人多灵巧！
diagnose: It is not easy to diagnose a baby.
给小宝宝看病可不容易。
Can you diagnose why the robot will not start?
你能查得出机器人为什么启动不了吗？
diagnosis: The computer gave a fast diagnosis.
Was the diagnosis right about the robot?
The diagnosis was easy, too much candy!
诊断很简单：糖吃得太多啦！
